purpose: Gate HUNT launch on evidence-backed responsive integrity, initial DOM/image budgets, touch targets, critical browser errors and PWA cache/update behavior.
performance_rules: Initial homepage DOM must be bounded; catalog breadth belongs behind progressive shelf mounting and category pagination.
No product is removed from the catalog merely to satisfy homepage performance budgets.
Local timing numbers are diagnostic only; Preview/Production Web Vitals require a real deployed origin.
Critical storefront/API failures are launch blockers; intentional local-origin CORS failures are not counted once tested on an allowed origin.
A responsive rail may overflow inside its own scroll container, but the document itself may not horizontally overflow.
Each viewport QA is isolated in its own Chrome page to prevent navigation cancellation or scroll restoration from contaminating initial-load evidence.
pwa_rules: JS/CSS/JSON/webmanifest use network-first to prevent one-navigation stale builds.
Service Worker update checks bypass HTTP cache.
Cache namespace is versioned and old cache namespaces are deleted on activate.
Preview must prove update behavior, manifest/installability and offline shell before PWA readiness becomes PASS.
hard_rules: Never call local timing data a production Web Vitals result.
Never hide a network/console failure to obtain a PASS.
Never reduce Product Truth or remove catalog availability to fake a performance win.
Never call PWA readiness PASS until cache-update and installability are verified on Preview.
